verdict.rationale: Gram provides an in-dashboard agent harness (gram-docs-8) explicitly described as a way to pick a server, authenticate, chat with a model that invokes tools, and inspect logs before connecting a real client — directly matching the story of exercising tools from a browser-based playground pre-integration. This is first-party documentation with a clear feature name ('Connect') dedicated to this exact workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming the playground works as described, and more detail on tool-level interaction granularity within the UI.
